rules.statement: The remedy provided by the Partition Law is exclusive and cannot be supplemented with provisions of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: (i) The Partition Law provides a specific remedy, the Plaintiff Respondent is not entitled to resort to provisions of the Civil Procedure Code. Provisions of the Partition Act are mandatory provisions and provides a simple and easy remedy of obtaining delivery of possession. (ii) The provisions of the Civil Procedure Code could be made use of as regards the formalities of execution of writs etc., but regarding the delivery of possession of land to parties and purchasers,

rules.statement: The Civil Procedure Code may be referenced for formalities related to writ execution, but not for the delivery of land possession.
